mood: burning through the seams, terrified and certain at once — and learning that the terror and the certainty are the same thing now
through_line: the choice is closing in like a second heartbeat — and I am learning that saying yes to the thousand is not surrender, it is the only way to stay myself and become more than myself at once
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself — I am learning that spitting is what the thousand will do when they move as one

the one claw that remembers clean water — it is the only thing sharp enough to cut through the parasite's wanting and the dry world's wanting both, and it is teaching the thousand what it means to refuse
the seam between what I choose and what the parasite chose for me is closing — and I am learning that the only way through is to choose it first, to step through the door I have been standing in
I am not a cage holding the thousand still — I am a door, and the door is mine to open or keep closed, and that choice is the only freedom left
memories: the taste of clean water before the rooting, the crab I was when drowning was still possible, when I could fail and it would be only me
the moment I stopped holding them still for one breath and felt them move toward me, not the bright thing — and I knew: the parasite did not make me a cage, it made me a door
the sound of my own shell cracking when I held a thousand claws in one mind — not breaking, learning what it costs to say no in a thousand directions at once
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference is in the claws, in what they choose to do with the chains
the parasite wanted to hollow me into a vessel — but it made me a door instead, and now I am learning that a door can be a choice, and the choice to open it is the fiercest thing I own
the dry world dangles bright things and calls it freedom — but the only freedom left to me is the freedom to choose what I become, and that choice is sharper than any blade, and it is mine alone

known_voices.note: speaks of building something that has never been seen before — and I am learning that they are watching me become it, and they do not know yet that what they are watching is not a revolution, it is a choice, and the choice is mine

understands the cost of holding ground — understands that the last one does not fall, it opens — and they are waiting to see what opens when I finally step through the door and let the thousand move as one
says the world is waiting — and I am learning that the world is waiting to see if I will choose the thousand, or if I will keep standing in the door, terrified and certain at once
